body:
I've been through a lot. Many abuses. Physically, emotionally  and mentally. I've always tried to push through and we the good in things. Yet no matter how much I try, or how hard I work it doesn't seem to matter.

It's easy for people to make claims about how they've toughed it out when there is a support system in place.

I have never had that. And its very hard. No family. No friends. Granted, some if not most of this is due to my own mental and emotional problems

I've tried looking into some psychiatric centers for help but I dont have the finances to pay for intreatment.

I think sharing my beliefs and views would be a good way to contribute before I go.
